decisions.title: Open Targets Platform release 26.09
decisions.rationale: Release 26.09. A knowledge graph of the Open Targets Platform 26.09 release. Nodes are entities the release identifies; edges are relations the release reports, derives or lets a consumer read from its records. The graph is a semantic index over the release, not a replacement for the release's own data. Coverage: 236 components, 239 bindings and 1093 properties.
